novelty_search.nearest_results: H1/H4 recover 92.7%-107.1% of will/had attention 9, while the exact shared MLP4 local-value input accounts for only about 0.05 normalized recovery. Existing has/had and is/was source partitions use task-specific lexical banks and do not partition the new temporal construction.
novelty_search.new_question: Which complete semantic source group supplies the additional will/had payload read by the reused L9H1/H4 pair?

population: All 64 sealed A1/A2 will/had rows, split into the two fixed 32-row constructions. Each pair has equal length and exactly one temporal-cue token change.

source_partition.prefix: all tokens strictly before the temporal cue; empty in A1 and the fixed reporting frame in A2
source_partition.cue: the sole Tomorrow/Earlier or tomorrow/earlier token change
source_partition.subject_onset: the two tokens immediately after the cue: determiner plus head noun
source_partition.intervening_suffix: all tokens after subject onset and before the semantic query
source_partition.partition_control: The five groups are disjoint and cover every causal source position 0..query exactly once. Installing all groups must reproduce the complete donor H1/H4 head output within 1e-4 selected-logit error.

opposing_predictions.direct_temporal_cue: The cue group alone supplies at least half of the complete H1/H4 effect with donorward fraction at least 0.75 in A1 and A2; subject onset and self are secondary.
opposing_predictions.contextual_or_late_payload: Cue recovery is below half of full in either construction, and prefix, subject onset, intervening suffix, or nonlinear group interaction carries the missing effect.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_partit: All hashes and native capability hold; manual selected logits replay frozen native logits within 1e-4; H1/H4 source reconstruction and all-sources/full-pair selected-logit closure are within 1e-4; all 448 arm-row records are present and finite.
predictions.pred_b_complete_h1h4_recurrence: Complete H1/H4 mean recovery remains within 0.03 of 0.3440319120 in A1 and 0.3641600731 in A2, with direction fraction at least 0.75.
predictions.pred_c_literal_temporal_cue_dominates: Cue mean recovery is positive, at least 0.50 of full-pair recovery, and donorward fraction at least 0.75 in A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_d_subject_onset_and_self_secondary: Subject-onset and self mean absolute recovery are each at most 0.35 of full-pair recovery in A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_e_exact_zero_fit_price: Exactly 18 model forwards, 576 example evaluations, seven arms, 448 arm-row records, and zero fits/searches/backwards/updates.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: the shared H1/H4 reader directly reads a temporal-cue payload on will/had, rather than reusing the dominant MLP4 contextual input from has/had/is/was.
terminal.null: The instrument and complete-head recurrence pass but cue dominance or secondary-source predictions fail; retain the exact group effects and interaction boundary.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, replay, partition, source closure, recurrence, finiteness, coverage, or price fails.

scope: Controls are inherited from the immediately preceding selective H1/H4 head-group screen. This source screen identifies inputs within that fixed reader and does not identify upstream writers of the cue payload.
